default.description: Main window: session commands, reloading profiles and opening the profile file, taskbar flash and badge, program updates as sessions, workspace and scrollback, notes (private and shared project notes, including turning shared notes on and unlocking them), folder dialog, clipboard text, pasting a clipboard image as a saved file, opening the detached side panel window (fixed label and URL, remembered size and place), desktop notifications, the CPU and memory of each session's process tree, the machine's CPU, memory and GPU for the system bar, push to the phone (ntfy or Pushover settings with secrets in the keychain, a test push, a push for a session's new state), git branches and changes, the user's own commit activity for the calendar in the empty window, the commit history (one page of commits and the changes of one commit), staging, unstaging, discarding and committing the files of a session's repository (by session ID), opening a local dev server address a session printed in the browser, the file tree of a session's folder (listing one folder at a time, never leaving it, and a bounded index of its paths for the filter) and opening one of its files in a read-only viewer window (fresh label, fixed URL and size), worktrees, local claims (overlaps between the user's own sessions), the agent gate (answering an agent's held edit, listing and deleting the standing answers), profile editing and keychain secrets, session export, notification area icon and showing the window, read-only sub-agent view, the context meter of the sessions, the Hangar account (sign-in, projects, the signed-in person's profile picture, opening its own pages), the team connection (sharing a project, confirming new devices, linking repositories, the sessions' states for the team's presence, reserving tasks and answering release requests), updates and restart

file-viewer.description: Read-only file viewer windows: reading the one file the backend bound to the calling window (no path argument), its change stamp for the live refresh and its diff against the last commit, opening a checked http(s) link of the Markdown preview in the browser, listening to events, copying text, setting its title, focusing and closing it

panel.description: Detached side panel window (Notes, Changes, Files): the note commands (private and shared project notes, including turning shared notes on and unlocking them), reading the changes and the commit history of a folder, staging, unstaging, discarding and committing the files of a session's repository (by session ID), listing a session's folder (one folder at a time, and a bounded index of its paths for the filter) and opening one of its files in a read-only viewer, listening to events, messages to the main window through the backend only, copying text, keeping itself on top (its own command only), focusing and closing it (close, then destroy once pending input is saved). The git actions name a session by ID and change only that session's repository; no commands that start, write to, resize or end sessions, and text reaches a session only as a validated paste through the main window (panel_to_main)
